title: Interactive Learning Studio: staged implementation
summary: Connects isolated coding tools, deterministic math and quizzes, flashcards, whiteboard and guided projects to learning progress and opt-in AI help.

changes.detail: Offline bundled QuickJS/TypeScript/SQLite execution in disposable workers, bounded output, cancellation, runtime tests, source snapshots and execution history.
HTML/CSS preview; actual React static rendering with explicit non-hydrated limitations; guided Next.js tasks.
Expression parser, graph and motion experiment, explicit quiz grading, SM-2 flashcards, SVG whiteboard, evidence-based guided projects and consent-gated contextual mentor.
Adds Home and Practice Lab navigation and persistent Python execution history. No previous tool removed.

validation.name: Implementation checks pending
validation.detail: Unit/integration, browser, lint and typechecks pending. Native device behavior, live paid AI, full React hydration, Next.js server execution, and hard Python WASM memory limits are not verified or implemented. No deployment.
